answer: Use stake-backed rotating workload receipts. 1) New keys lock 35 POA for 24 days and sign a task hash before assignment. 2) A public beacon draws four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from separate funding clusters replay samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied output fingerprints, or synchronized cash-outs merge accounts into one seat, and a proven duplicate loses half its bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 35,000 POA, risks 17,500, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 audits. Like opal catching zephyr light, each wanderer leaves one track back to its source.
